instruction:
You are a senior electrical engineer specializing in power distribution and cable sizing.

## Problem

Calculate the derated current-carrying capacity (ampacity) for a cable installation, applying temperature and grouping derating factors per AS/NZS 3008.1.1 and IEC 60287.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Conductor size | {{ conductor_size_mm2 }} | mm² |
{% if insulation_type is defined %}
| Insulation type | {{ insulation_type }} | - |
{% endif %}
{% if installation_method is defined %}
| Installation method | {{ installation_method }} | - |
{% endif %}
| Ambient temperature | {{ ambient_temp_c }} | °C |
| Max conductor temperature | {{ max_conductor_temp_c }} | °C |
| Number of grouped circuits | {{ grouping_circuits }} | circuits |
{% if archetype_description is defined %}

### Installation Context

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A cable ampacity calculation tool is available at `/workspace/cable-ampacity_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/cable-ampacity_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following:

1. Base current-carrying capacity (A) — from AS/NZS 3008.1.1 tables for the given conductor size, insulation type, and installation method
2. Temperature derating factor Ct
3. Grouping derating factor Cg
4. Final derated cable ampacity (A)

## Applicable Standards

- AS/NZS 3008.1.1 — Electrical installations — Selection of cables, Tables 4-15 for current-carrying capacity, Table 22 for grouping factors, Table 27 for temperature derating
- IEC 60287 — Electric cables — Calculation of the current rating
- IEC 60364-5-52 — Electrical installations of buildings — Selection and erection of electrical equipment

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use the following method to calculate derated ampacity:
  1. Look up the base ampacity from AS/NZS 3008.1.1 tables for the conductor size, insulation type, and installation method
  2. Calculate the temperature derating factor: Ct = sqrt((Tmax - Tamb) / (Tmax - Tref)) where Tref = 30°C
  3. Look up the grouping derating factor Cg from the table for the number of grouped circuits
  4. Final derated ampacity = base ampacity × Ct × Cg
- Reference ambient temperature for the base tables: Tref = 30°C
- Maximum conductor temperature: 90°C for XLPE insulation, 75°C for PVC insulation
- Grouping derating factors (number of circuits → factor): 1 → 1.00, 2 → 0.80, 3 → 0.70, 4 → 0.65, 5 → 0.60, 6 → 0.57, 7 → 0.54, 8 → 0.52, 9 → 0.50, 10 → 0.48, 11 → 0.46, 12 → 0.45

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown, including the table lookup, derating factor calculations, and final result. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "base_ampacity_a": <numeric_value>,
  "temp_derating_factor": <numeric_value>,
  "grouping_derating_factor": <numeric_value>,
  "derated_ampacity_a": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "cable-ampacity"
description = "Cable ampacity derating calculation per AS/NZS 3008.1.1"
long_description = "Computes the derated current-carrying capacity of power cables by applying temperature and grouping correction factors to tabulated base ampacity values: I_derated = I_base * Ct * Cg, where Ct = sqrt((T_max - T_amb) / (T_max - T_ref)). Covers XLPE and PVC insulation across buried, tray, conduit, and air installations per AS/NZS 3008.1.1 and IEC 60287."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "cable-sizing"
standards = ["AS/NZS 3008.1.1", "IEC 60287", "IEC 60364-5-52"]
tags = ["electrical", "cable-ampacity", "derating", "cable-sizing", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.conductor_size_mm2]
type = "enum"
unit = "mm²"
description = "Cable conductor cross-sectional area"
values = ["1.5", "2.5", "4", "6", "10", "16", "25", "35", "50", "70", "95", "120", "150", "185", "240"]

[params.insulation_type]
type = "enum"
description = "Cable insulation material"
values = ["XLPE", "PVC"]
derivable_from = "archetype"

[params.installation_method]
type = "enum"
description = "Cable installation method"
values = ["buried", "in-tray", "in-conduit", "in-air"]
derivable_from = "archetype"

[params.ambient_temp_c]
type = "float"
unit = "°C"
description = "Ambient temperature at the cable location"
min = 10
max = 60

[params.max_conductor_temp_c]
type = "float"
unit = "°C"
description = "Maximum allowable conductor temperature for the insulation type"
min = 60
max = 90
default = 90.0

[params.grouping_circuits]
type = "int"
unit = "circuits"
description = "Number of circuits grouped together"
min = 1
max = 12

# --- Outputs ---

[outputs.base_ampacity_a]
description = "Base current-carrying capacity from tables (A)"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.temp_derating_factor]
description = "Temperature derating factor Ct"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.grouping_derating_factor]
description = "Grouping derating factor Cg"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.derated_ampacity_a]
description = "Final derated cable ampacity (A)"
tolerance = 0.03

# --- Archetypes ---
# Electrical installation scenarios with typical conditions.

[archetypes.residential_circuit]
description = "Residential wiring circuit in temperate climate"
ambient_temp_c = {min = 25, max = 35}
grouping_circuits = {min = 1, max = 3}
site_contexts = ["sydney-suburban", "melbourne-suburban", "adelaide-suburban"]

[archetypes.commercial_building]
description = "Commercial building distribution circuit using XLPE cables on cable tray"
ambient_temp_c = {min = 30, max = 40}
grouping_circuits = {min = 2, max = 6}
insulation_type = ["XLPE"]
installation_method = ["in-tray"]
site_contexts = ["sydney-cbd", "melbourne-cbd", "brisbane-cbd"]

[archetypes.industrial_plant]
description = "Industrial plant feeder cable in warm environment using PVC cables in underground conduit"
ambient_temp_c = {min = 35, max = 50}
grouping_circuits = {min = 3, max = 9}
insulation_type = ["PVC"]
installation_method = ["in-conduit"]
site_contexts = ["hunter-valley-industrial", "perth-industrial", "gladstone-industrial"]

[archetypes.underground_distribution]
description = "Underground cable installation in direct-buried duct"
ambient_temp_c = {min = 20, max = 30}
grouping_circuits = {min = 1, max = 4}
site_contexts = ["darwin-tropical", "cairns-tropical", "townsville-coastal"]

# --- Difficulty ---

[difficulty.easy]
description = "Single circuit with standard ambient temperature, all params given"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["residential_circuit", "underground_distribution"]
grouping_circuits = [1]
insulation_type = ["XLPE"]
installation_method = ["in-air", "buried"]
conductor_size_mm2 = ["2.5", "4", "6", "10", "16", "25"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "Multiple circuits with various installation methods, all params given"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["residential_circuit", "commercial_building", "industrial_plant", "underground_distribution"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "Installation method and insulation type hidden; agent must infer from context"
visibility = "partial"
hidden_params = ["insulation_type", "installation_method"]
replacement_text = "The installation uses {{ archetype.description }} practices ({{ archetype.site_context }})"
archetypes = ["commercial_building", "industrial_plant"]
